The Dissertation

Ph.D. Dissertation, NYU 1986

The Impossible Press

American Journalism and the Decline of Public Life

Advisor: Neil Postman

In 1986, Jay Rosen completed his doctoral dissertation under Neil Postman at New York University. Nearly four decades later, his analysis of the troubled relationship between press and public reads less like historical scholarship and more like prophecy.

The dissertation argues that the phrase "the press informs the public" obscures more than it reveals. Professional standards cannot solve structural problems in the press-public relationship. The "impossible press" Rosen described has only become more impossible in the age of social media and algorithmic news distribution.
